_doc: What dresses the town of the sim (scripts/pueblo_vivo.gd over pueblo.gd; docs/construccion.md, «Pueblo vivo»). Every piece id is one of the catalogues of LandmarkBuilder (kit/extras, kit/landmarks). Nothing here stands on a tile the sim walks unless it is on a tile corner or edge and walkers are steered round it (lamps, stone benches, trees, hedges); the rest goes on tiles nobody walks (yards, the well's tile, the board's, water). `well` / `board`: the piece on the plaza well's tile and on the notice board's ('' keeps @pozo / @cartel). `lamps`: `decor` (a post for every lantern of the 2D decor), `plaza` (posts on the corners of the plaza), `shadows` (how many of the lit lamps nearest the camera cast shadows, at night and at zoom <= shadow_zoom), `energy` (light energy at night; the catalogue gives colour and range), `light_at` / `glow_at` (optional, plan x, y, z in the piece; by default the catalogue's light.at and light.glow). `benches`: the piece for the decor benches. `trough`: set into the edge of a yard that faces a street, near the plaza. `cart`: a cart and its beast in the yard nearest the market where they fit. `dock`: a ramp on a yard tile by the river, pier modules on the water and a moored boat. `decor`: decor prop id -> piece placed by its footprint in the yard of its tile. `trees`: decor tree family -> candidates ('q:' Stylized Nature, 't:' kit/trees family), `fruit`: fruit pieces by season for the fruit trees. `yards`: what the yard of a building gets, by its look (type; houses by wealth): pieces (`chance` 0-1, by the dice of the house) and `beasts` (animal id, `n`; they need free ground). `beasts`: `max_animated` (animals animated at once, the nearest the camera; each costs 6 draw calls, a bird 4), `anim_zoom` (past this zoom every animal is its still pose), `roam` (loose animals: where). `crops`: fields of up to `small_max` tiles grow `small`, the rest `big`; `phase`: crop -> season -> 1 sown, 2 growing, 3 harvest (0: bare soil). `banner_colors`: the cloths of the market banners, in turn (market_banner). `crops.mix`: crop -> season -> a field in strips across its long side (sown, young: green shoots, stubble, stooks: ploughed across with a stook on some tiles nobody walks, plot: a vegetable bed). `lamps.well_lamp`: a post on a corner of the fountain's tile, for the middle of the plaza. `convoy`: in the sim (sim3d.gd), a cart and its beast that cross the town along the main road instead of the parked `cart`: `trips` [hour, east|west], `pace` (of a walker's), `outside` (m past the map's edge where it starts and ends). `flock`: pigeons circling over the plaza by day (Flock.make opts). `mill`: the water mill's own look (LandmarkBuilder.build opts: palette of kit/variants).
